description:
Most people are sure they could beat at least one animal in an unarmed fight. We took ten real animals, from the goose and the house cat to the saltwater crocodile, the polar bear and the African elephant, ranked them by how badly a human would lose, and sent Doug in against every one.

Which animal do you think you could actually beat? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
